'''Sharbah''' was a commodity traded in the galaxy. It was packaged in cartons and was required to be frozen to preserve it when transported in the cargo holds of [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>
